label: Bible Study
prompt: Though thy beginning was small, yet thy _____ end should greatly increase.
verse: Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase.
note: Bildad meant it as a lecture, but it came true — Job's latter end was blessed more than his beginning.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never _____; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
verse: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
note: Jesus offers a Samaritan woman at a well water that ends thirst for good — a spring inside you.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he asked for a writing _____, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.
verse: And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.
note: Struck mute, Zacharias asked for a 'writing table' — a tablet — to settle his son's name once and for all: John.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the LORD said unto Moses, Is the LORD'S hand waxed _____? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.
verse: And the LORD said unto Moses, Is the LORD'S hand waxed short? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.
note: Moses doubted God could feed 600,000 men meat for a month; God answered with a sky full of quail.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: I counsel thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that thou mayest be rich; and white raiment, that thou mayest be clothed, and that the shame of thy nakedness do not appear; and anoint thine eyes with _____, that thou mayest see.
verse: I counsel thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that thou mayest be rich; and white raiment, that thou mayest be clothed, and that the shame of thy nakedness do not appear; and anoint thine eyes with eyesalve, that thou mayest see.
note: Laodicea thought itself rich; Jesus prescribes tried gold, white raiment, and 'eyesalve' so they can finally see.
